job: Between patients, wipe down the high-touch ledges in the clinic: the corridor window sill and the ledge at the reception desk in the waiting room.
understood_as: Between patients, wipe down two high-touch surfaces in the clinic: the corridor window sill and the reception desk ledge in the waiting room.
steps: Wipe the window sill in the corridor.
Move to the waiting room and wipe the ledge at the reception desk.

demos.why: Shows the stroke pattern and how hard to press the cloth along a narrow ledge or sill so the whole surface is covered.
Sets how firmly to grip the cloth so it does not slip or bunch up while it is dragged and pressed across the surface.

questions: Where is the clean cloth kept? No location for it has been recorded, so the robot cannot fetch it yet. Please tell us where it is, or have the cloth placed with the robot before each round.
Should the cloth be damp or used with a disinfectant? The robot can only wipe with a cloth. It cannot spray or apply cleaning liquid, so someone would need to prepare the cloth.
How will the robot know a patient has left? There is no trigger for 'between patients' in the plan, so please say whether staff will start each round or whether it should run on a fixed schedule.
What should happen to the used cloth afterwards, for example a laundry bin or a waste bin? No drop-off point has been located for it.
